text: On it. Investigating the required-flag handling in src/click/core.py and fixing it so a missing required flag raises a usage error (exit code 2).
Got it — bug #2 (echo with None stdout/stderr across _compat.py, _termui_impl.py, utils.py) is being worked on in parallel with #1.
Still in progress: root cause identified in core.py, fix being applied and verified against the full test suite. ETA ~4 min.

Fixed and verified. Root cause: in Option.__init__, a flag with no explicit default was always given default=False, so a required flag that was omitted looked satisfied and never raised MissingParameter. Now the default is only forced to False (or () for multiple) when the flag is not required, so a missing required flag raises "Missing option '--flag'" with exit code 2. Full repo suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed, 0 failures.
Fixed and verified: required flags now raise "Missing option" (exit 2). Full suite green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Bug #7 (symlink resolution in types.py Path) received and being worked on now.

Fixed and verified. Root cause: in decorators.py, argument()'s inner decorator did `attrs.pop("cls", Argument)` on the shared closure dict, so the second use of the same decorator lost cls (and other kwargs). It now copies attrs first, like option() already did. Reused decorators preserve the custom cls; full suite green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Fixed and verified. Root cause: Path.convert with resolve_path=True called os.readlink() and then realpath() on the raw link target, so relative symlink targets were resolved against the CWD (and exists/readable/writable checks used the unresolved value). It now resolves via pathlib.Path(rv).resolve() and runs the access checks on the resolved path. Symlinks to files/dirs/chains now resolve correctly; full suite green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Fixed and verified. Root cause: click assumed sys.stdout/sys.stderr are never None; the cached stream helper wrapped None and echo() then crashed with AttributeError. Now _make_cached_stream_func returns None for a None source, echo() returns early when the resolved stream is None, and ProgressBar/pager fall back to an io.StringIO placeholder. echo/echo_via_pager/progressbar no longer raise with detached streams; full suite green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).
